'''August 2001 Virginia tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in King George County, Virginia on 19 August 2001. [[Devon Clark]] won it. It is known from Devon Clark's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2882">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-22-richmond-va-8-19-01d2882/ richmond-va-8-19-01], DeckTech (Devon "Devonator" Clark, 22 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-22-richmond-va-8-19-01d2882/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 August 2001
* '''Site:''' King George County, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Devon Clark]]
